content.short: FBTC is a decentralized, omnichain Bitcoin-backed asset designed to unleash BTC's utility in DeFi.
content.description: FBTC is a decentralized and highly secure omnichain protocol that enables seamless integration of Bitcoin liquidity across various blockchain ecosystems. By minting a fully backed, 1:1 Bitcoin-pegged asset, the platform allows BTC holders to actively participate in decentralized finance applications, including yield farming, lending, and trading. Designed with robust cryptographic verification, FBTC ensures strong peg maintenance and deep capital efficiency for users.
